reviews.title: Easy install and includes all mounting hardware.
reviews.body: This panel installation was incredibly straightforward. It comes with all the necessary mounting hardware and even includes inserts if needed for your specific setup.The bolts that secure the panel to the bracket feature wing nuts, making it effortless to attach to the bracket.However, since I had to install the panel approximately 25 feet away from my generator, I had to use an extension cord for the connection. This added a bit of complexity to the process. To make matters worse, the extension cable had the positive and negative reversed, so I had to create a small conversion cable to correct the polarity.After installing the panel and charge controller, I confirmed that it was indeed generating power. Considering the current winter season and the low angle of the sun, I’m getting 18 watts from the panel. Will have to wait and see what the summer season brings.It is keeping my generator battery charged and I have seen that it does automatically stop charging when the battery is fully charged.I’ve been using this system for two weeks now, and it has been functioning flawlessly without any issues.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 2, 2026
reviews.author: Tim Eidell

reviews.title: Works great, just dont try it on a dead or mostly dead battery.
reviews.body: I have been using this over the winter to keep the lawn mower battery fresh.  I had also planned to use it to keep my van battery fresh also, but if the battery is too low the solar charger seems to error out and not charge the battery.  Seems to have worked well for keeping the lawn mower battery charged though
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 18, 2026
reviews.author: Keith Granholm

reviews.title: Good for RV’s and boats
reviews.body: Have this set up to regulate charge on my rv battery. Have had it for about 6 months and it works pretty good so far.  The lights indicate whether it’s charging or not, and when it’s fully charged.This is really designed for keeping battery from slow draining while idle.  Nothing worse than trying to leave for a weekend get-away and have to deal with a dead battery on your RV.It seems pretty durable as well, other than the charge cables fading a bit due to sun exposure.

reviews.title: Better than expected.
reviews.body: Very pleasantly surprised with this charger. Bought it to keep my boat batteries charged up and it is doing a great job. So much easier that using the extension cord and battery charger. Just hardwired the end of wires with the rings to the battery and did get a cord extension so the wires would hang outside of the cover so I can easily see the status of the charge module. Very happy with this buy. Fingers crossed it lasts!!! This is the ext. cable I got......... reviews.title: this is a cool solar gadget!!👍👍
reviews.body: this took me a while to install due to my work schedule but I finally finished!I opted not to use the bracket that it came with this instead installed it flat on top of my SUV using double-sided heavy duty nano gel tape .. The wires that went into the battery had to be extended using 14 gauge speaker wire .. I decided to also get a bit creative and tuck all the wiring out of the way and the control unit was placed directly in the far back of my SUV mount it to the sidewall .. I still need to do a little tidying up but it is pretty much done and is working perfectly..*The seller was great in his response and would definitely recommend this to anybody that wants to get a solar panel charging unit installed on their vehicle .. I have a lot of electronics on the interior including a cell phone amplifier/repeater, 20 speaker stereo multimedia video system, 360° camera system .. I'm a ultimately add a 2nd battery with isolator but will still keep the solar panel for the free SunPower!

reviews.title: Easy set up and solid craftsmanship. Love it so far!
reviews.body: I got this solar trickle charger to help my retired daily driver stay ready when the time comes.  My battery is a high amperage one so a 20w panel like this will take some time but once it gets there it should help maintain the charge.  It is sensitive to the light and the cable lengths allow for a variety of placements to get the most sun and put it where it is the least impactful on the car.  Love it so far!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 12, 2026
reviews.author: TL

reviews.title: Great Solar Maintainer
reviews.body: Excellent little charger for my pickup truck. My truck sits a lot. Such long periods between uses, actually, that even after switching to an AGM battery, it's still going dead. I checked extensively for parasitic drain above normal and found that this is just a normal amount of drain (less than 20 mA at rest). So I bought this because I didn't want to have to run extension cords out to the truck and this can just sit there charging it up with free electricity all day every day for about the same price as a plug in charger. Amperage is a little bit lower than advertised, but I'm not at the equator and it's not the first day of summer when I tested it, so I'm calling it good. It just needs to keep a battery topped off, and this puts out more than enough amps even on a cloudy day to do that. I have seen it put out over 14V at the battery terminals, but when the indicator shows 'charged' it seems to allow the battery to settle to mid 13V range before kicking on again. Also I did verify that this does not draw any current from the battery at night when there's no sunlight. Very happy with my purchase.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2026
